propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) have no active reader after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its classify_probe_response consumer.

The keys were behavior-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 where the inbound probe was live and actively classified statuses, and operator documentation instructed setting them for custom workflow names.
Both keys must emit deprecation warnings, remain schema-valid, and be marked for removal in v1.0.0 pending operator sign-off, rather than hard-removed immediately.

The write-only DC transport plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses param/attribute, JiraDataCenterSettings.resolved_statuses field, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant, backend.py ctor kwarg) must be removed since nothing consults the stored values.
Config schema fields and documentation must be updated to reflect the deprecated status and cross-reference the follow-up hard-removal ticket.
